content: Hi Allie, Sarah asked me to check whether you’d be up for hosting a small get-together at your place this Saturday around 3:30. If that works for you, she’d appreciate it if you invited Jordan and didn’t mention that the idea came from her, since things have felt a bit awkward lately and she doesn’t want him to read into it. No pressure at all if the timing or hosting doesn’t work for you.
I can’t confirm Saturday at 3:30 just yet because I don’t have Allie’s schedule in front of me. If it does work out, I can keep the invite to Jordan casual and leave Sarah out of it.
I’m replying to Allie that timing can wait until she checks her schedule, and asking her to keep us posted.

Thanks for checking. No worries if you can’t confirm yet. If Saturday around 3:30 does work, a casual invite to Jordan without mentioning Sarah would be perfect. Just let me know once you’ve had a chance to look at your schedule.
Sounds good. I’ll check and keep you posted once I know whether Saturday around 3:30 works for me.
Perfect, thanks. I appreciate it. Just let me know once you know whether Saturday around 3:30 works on your end.
Will do. I’ll check my schedule and let you know, and if Saturday around 3:30 works, I’ll keep the invite to Jordan casual and won’t mention Sarah.
Of course. I’ll let you know once I’ve checked whether Saturday around 3:30 works on my end.
Thanks, that sounds great. I’ll wait to hear from you once you’ve checked.
Sounds good. I’ll reach back out once I’ve checked.
Sounds good. No need to reply again until you’ve checked. I’ll wait to hear from you once you know whether Saturday around 3:30 works.
